'''Yang Water Monkey''' (壬申, ''mizunoe saru''; onyomi ''jinshin'') is the 9th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 9th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Metal Goat|ja|辛未}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Water Rooster|ja|癸酉}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''壬'' is Yang Water, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''申'' (Monkey) is Yang Metal; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Water Monkey (壬申)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): rénshēn
** Cantonese (Jyutping): jam4 san1
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: mizunoe-saru
*** On'yomi: jinshin
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): imsinn (임신)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Nhâm Thân

==Months of Yang Water Monkey==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 4 or 9 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Kinoe (甲)|ja|甲|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kou}} or {{ill|Tsuchinoto (己)|ja|己|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ki}}), the month of {{ill|July|en|July|qid=Q121|lt=July}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=Month}} of {{ill|Yang Water Monkey|ja|壬申|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Renjin|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Liqiu|en|Liqiu|qid=Q1147421|lt=Beginning of Autumn}} until the day before {{ill|Bailu (solar term)|en|Bailu (solar term)|qid=Q1191003|lt=White Dew}}) as applicable.

==Days of Yang Water Monkey==
The {{ill|Senjitsu|ja|選日|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/selected day}} for {{ill|Yang Water Monkey|ja|壬申|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Renjin|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} is as follows.

==={{nihongo|selection days|選日|senjitsu}}===
The day of {{ill|Yang Water Monkey|ja|壬申|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Renjin|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} is the 3rd day of {{ill|Tsuchi (Japanese term)|ja|犯土|lt=Large Earth|lt_ja=大土|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hanto|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11571306}}.

It refers to the period from 16:00 to 18:00.
